fields.Name: T90 - Cross-Domain Member Traverse
fields.Description: Verifies a Member full record connects across multiple domains by traversing to two different related areas from the same member form.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity grid — type 'Members' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the EXACT 'Members' match (not 'Board Members'/'Memberships'/etc.); if that is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Members. Then click a member row and click 'Open Full Record'. On the member's form, scroll to the related-records sections and view at least ONE related area showing the member's connected data (e.g. Certifications, Memberships, Enrollments, Invoices, or Event Registrations) — confirming the member connects to other domains. Seeing one related section with the member's related rows (or a valid empty-state) is sufficient; you do NOT need to traverse multiple records. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Member record full form is open
At least one related-records section is shown with the member's related data (rows or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
